title: performance_json
description: Performance figures of an aircraft type, stored as a JSON object in the performance_json column of data/aircraft_types.csv (blank when no source gives a figure). One key per figure, each with {value, unit, reference_id, note}; a key is absent when no source gives it. Keys mirror schema/vocabularies.json (aircraft_performance_key). Used by scripts/validate.py check_aircraft_types.

value.description: The figure as the source states it, including its qualifier (for example '27,000 long tons (standard)').

unit.description: Unit of the figure where the value is a bare number, otherwise blank or absent.

reference_id.description: The reference (data/references_meta.csv) that gives this figure.

note.description: Optional: sub-type, variant, or as-built versus as-designed remark.

max_speed.description: Maximum speed with the altitude or weight the source gives.
